literal_meaning: ঘড়ি বা মেশিনের স্প্রিংয়ে পাক দেওয়া
figurative_meaning_en: to infuse energy or power into something
example_sentences_in_bangla: ঘড়িটায় দম দিন, নাহলে থেমে যাবে।
example_sentences_in_english: Wind up the doll to make it move.
Give the clock some wind, or it will stop.
note: Refers to the action of winding mechanical devices, commonly used in everyday Bengali speech for toys and clocks.
